title: QUIC Loss Detection and Congestion Control
summary: Describes how QUIC detects lost packets and controls congestion. It covers the timers and acknowledgment-based logic used to decide that data needs to be resent, and a congestion controller that keeps senders from overloading the network.

eli5.summary: QUIC has to notice when a packet is lost and slow down when the road is crowded. This explains how it does both.

questions: how does quic detect packet loss
